decisions.reason: As a small, incremental burner component embedded in the established radiant-heating business, it is likely to stay because its continued presence suggests no major aspiration shortfall and the growing firm can absorb modest uncertainty.

This electric infrared panel heater remains a core strategic line in the shift toward lower-carbon solutions, so management would continue to tolerate uncertainty and allocate attention to learning rather than withdrawal.

The electric halogen infrared heater is still the most plausible candidate for pruning because it is less central to the firm's future direction and could fall below aspirations relative to stronger adjacent lines, but survival so far argues against an immediate drop.

Because this industrial electric infrared hall heater line fits the firm's core customer applications and broad systems offer, management would probably retain it unless results clearly underperform aspiration levels.
